Frequently Asked Questions About Interior, Exterior, and Commercial Painters in Gig Harbor, WA
Do you offer low-odor or eco-friendly paints for interior residential painting?

Absolutely. We offer zero-VOC and low-VOC interior paint options from Sherwin-Williams that deliver a rich, durable finish without harsh chemicals. This allows you and your family to remain comfortably in your home during and immediately after the interior painting process.
How often should a deck be stained or sealed in this region?

Due to the high levels of rainfall in Western Washington, we generally recommend having your wood deck cleaned and sealed or stained every 2 to 3 years. Regular maintenance prevents the wood from cracking, warping, and succumbing to rot.
What exterior preparation do you use to protect Gig Harbor homes against coastal moisture and salt air?

Coastal properties can weather faster because of damp marine conditions, humidity, and algae growth. Before painting, we apply a specialized mildewcide wash and low-pressure rinse to kill hidden spores. We then seal all exposed gaps with caulk and apply high-bonding, moisture-resistant exterior primers built to flex with Puget Sound’s shifting temperatures without cracking.
Can you phase a large townhome or multi-family project to help manage our association's budget?

Absolutely. We routinely work with HOA, COA, and TOA boards to design multi-year or multi-phase painting strategies. This allows your association to spread out maintenance costs over multiple fiscal periods while ensuring your community receives consistent protection.
What happens if I'm not satisfied with a specific part of the paint job?

Our job isn't finished until you say it is. We walk through the completed project with you to inspect our work. If you notice any area that requires a touch-up or adjustment, our team will correct it immediately. You only make your payment once you are completely satisfied with the results.
